comment: Dr. Gunkel is an amazing professor. Syntax can be difficult but Dr. Gunkel does an amazing job of explaining concepts. If you need more help, he always makes time to meet with students outside of class 1on1. He is very open to feedback and understnding of the needs of students. I definitely recommend taking any of his classes!
It's a tough class, but he makes sure you're understanding the content before moving forward in the class.

We love Dr. Gunkel! His syntax class can be hard if you don't pay attention to the lecture or put effort into the homework assignments. BUT he is very accessible outside of class and so kind. If you put in effort and go to office hours you can get a good grade! He's also just one of the funniest profs I've ever had!

Great professor. He takes his time to make sure you understand what is going on if you need the help. Be sure to ask lots of questions when you can, or he'll assume you understand. Office hours were very easy to set up and he was extremely helpful.
Love this guy! Great professor and wants you to succeed. very helpful with difficult material.

Dr. Gunkel is my favorite professor I have had. He makes class fun and is always making jokes. I love hearing his stories. As long as you do the homework and review the content you will do fine. He is always available for office hours. I would love to take another class with him and cannot recommend him enough.

Professor Gunkel has a great sense of humor and is really great about working with his students. He gives translations every class, but they are manageable if you manage your time efficiently. He gives daily quizzes which help to inflate your grade and he gives a sample exam before the real one. Class is enjoyable and not too difficult if you try.

Class is difficult if you don't have any prior knowledge (most people don't, though, so not a big deal). Dr. Gunkel definitely wants everyone to succeed and will let the class redo/correct assignments if he notices that a lot of people struggled. Nice professor.
one of the kindest professors. the content is difficult, but he is very chill and truly wants to see everyone succeed

I think Professor Gunkel gets a lot of hate for no reason. He has a hilariously dry sense of humor, and the assigned homework is fair and helpful for learning latin. He tells you exactly what will be on the quizzes, which are a really great way to inflate your grade. He gave us a study guide for each midterm that looked identical to the test.

Had him for Intro to Syntax. The textbook wasn't good, but he went over all the material in class, and was great at explaining. Would postpone assessments or allow us to redo homework if he saw a lot of students were struggling. Very helpful when seeking assistance outside class. Generally a flexible and kind professor. Hope to take him again.

Gunkel is a pretty good professor. He's new and way to advance for beginner latin students/course, but he works with us. He tries to hear what the students have to say. His exams are hard, but then again, they're predictable. TAKE HIM FOR HIGHER LEVEL LATIN OR LINGUISTICS! He def knows linguistics and could be The Source for the L-minor.

Awful Professor. Expects students to learn all the material on their own, without much explanation from him during class time. I've never studied longer for a class, just to feel absolutely unprepared on every test and quiz. DO NOT TAKE HIM FOR LATIN!!! Absolute GPA tanker.

Really cool guy, kind of a nerd but he's super nice and understanding and willing to work with you if you have conflicts. Incredibly knowledgeable in his field. Planning to take more courses with him in later semesters.
Hes good! Could warn us of quizzes and go easy on HW, but overall a really good professor!

Dr. Gunkel expects students to learn all of the vocab and grammar on their own for homework. He won't help with grammar issues in class, and only takes about his real passion: "the origin of different languages and where words come from." Class is pointless to attend because you learn no Latin in class. But you have to attend to do his daily quiz.
